mapper.sql: id, title, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, apply_user, approver, process_instance_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bpmn_leave WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM bpmn_leave WHERE apply_user = #{applyUser} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bpmn_leave (title, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, apply_user, approver, process_instance_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{leaveType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{applyUser}, #{approver}, #{processInstanceId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
